_note: Synthetic evaluation set, not field data. Every message was written for this repo; no real customer, official, account or message. Each one is labelled 'scam' or 'genuine' by what it really is, not by what Satyapan is expected to say. 'in_scope' is false for scam types Satyapan does not claim to cover (family emergency, lottery, job, sextortion...): they are reported separately and never hidden. `satyapan evaluate` runs this file together with the 22 scenarios and the variant corpus (data/fixtures/variants.json), labelled as set out in satyapan/evaluate.py.
